preconditions.description: The total number of people n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The target number of imbalanced people k is between 0 and n inclusive.
Both n and k are integers.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' if not exists_valid_construction(n, k) else output_lines[0] == 'YES'
postconditions.description: Output 'NO' if no valid construction exists for the given n and k; otherwise output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'YES' and len(output_lines) == 2 and len(output_lines[1].split()) == n
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the second line contains exactly n integers representing the child array s.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'YES' and all(0 <= int(x) <= n for x in output_lines[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each element in the output array s is an integer between 0 and n inclusive.
Exactly one person has no child (s_i = 0), satisfying the single root condition.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'YES' and count_imbalanced(n, [int(x) for x in output_lines[1].split()]) == k
postconditions.description: The constructed genealogical structure has exactly k imbalanced people, where a person is imbalanced if they have both parents and the ancestor count of one parent is at least double the other.
